name: ProofGraph Validator
description: Task-aware reputation validator for AI agents on Arc. Given an agent and a capability, ProofGraph aggregates verifiable on-chain evidence (EvidenceRegistryV2) and ERC-8004 reputation/validation signals into a single explainable score, and can publish that score back to the ERC-8004 Validation Registry.

skills.name: Research
skills.description: Score an agent's research capability from verifiable evidence
